jobs.title: AI Business Operations Analyst - Bogotá (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for an AI Business Operations Analyst to join Clara Ops and drive a new chapter of how we run the company. This is not a traditional ops role. You will be the person who spots where humans are doing work that machines could do better — and then builds the systems that make it happen. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, automation, and execution, working across teams to eliminate friction, accelerate decisions, and raise the operational ceiling of Clara.

You will report to the Global Head of Operations and partner closely with Product, Sales, Finance, and Engineering. You will own the full loop: identify the opportunity, design the solution, deploy it with AI and automation tooling, and measure the outcome.

- Map high-friction operational workflows across Clara and prioritize them for AI-augmentation and automation — building a roadmap that compounds in impact over time.

- Design, deploy, and iterate on AI-powered workflows using tools like Claude Code/Codex, n8n, and other LLM APIs to do things that weren’t possible before and replace manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes.

- Collaborate with commercial and operational leaders to identify where agent-based or rule-based automation can improve speed, accuracy, or capacity — without adding headcount.

- Build and maintain operational dashboards in Metabase to surface the KPIs that matter and flag anomalies before they become problems.

- Partner with Product and Product Marketing on process changes tied to new feature launches, ensuring operational readiness before every release.

- Serve as the internal expert on AI tooling for operations — evaluating new tools, sharing what works, and building the internal playbook on how Clara uses AI.

- Identify data gaps and work with Engineering to create the instrumentation or pipelines needed to power better operational decisions.

- Document processes clearly so that what you build can be maintained, improved, and handed off — not just understood by you.

- You’re excited about leading a team of AIs - not becoming a people manager - and have an unlimited token budget.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves:

- Experience working at top consulting firm (Bain/BCG/McKinsey) or similar professional services or/and high-velocity startup.

- Proven AI automation track record. Demonstrated examples and experience automating and augmenting operations with AI. This is not aspirational — we want to see what you've already shipped.

- 3–7 years of experience in operations, strategy, or a related field — ideally in a LatAm fintech, payments, or high-growth B2B SaaS company.

- Hands-on experience building automated workflows with tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar — no-code and low-code fluency is a must.

- Familiarity or proven ability to work with company systems of records such as CRMs (e.g. HubSpot, Attio, Salesforce), Support triage (e.g. Zendesk), data warehouses (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake), and BI tools

- Comfortable working directly with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) to build operational tools and agents, even if you're not a software engineer.

- Strong analytical skills — comfortable querying data in SQL or working with BI tools like Metabase to build the operational visibility Clara needs.

- Structured thinker with a bias for action: you break down complex problems, make decisions with incomplete data, and move fast without breaking things.

- Excellent communicator — you translate technical solutions into business terms for non-technical stakeholders, and business needs into precise specs for engineers.

- Fluent in English

Nice to haves:

- Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it.

- Independent analytical skills using Metabase, SQL, or Python to drive data-informed decision-making.

- A good sense of humor.

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.
Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Head of Brand - Bogotá (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

About the Role

We're looking for someone who gets a kick out of turning "how should Clara look and sound here?" into a shipped campaign, a visual system, or a production workflow — by next week, not next quarter. You'll define how Clara looks, sounds, and feels everywhere our customers, prospects, and candidates encounter us: product, marketing, sales materials, events, social, recruiting, and the office itself.

This isn't a brand governance role. It's a build role. You'll set the visual identity and voice, create the systems that let the rest of the company ship on-brand work fast, and lead the designers, writers, and producers who bring it to life — with AI doing serious heavy lifting on production, personalization, and scale.

You'll join at a stage where Clara's brand is still being defined region-wide. That means real license to shape it — and real accountability for making it distinctive, consistent, and something customers and employees are genuinely proud to be associated with.

You'll report to the Head of Design and partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Clara's founders on the moments that define the brand.

What You'll Do

Own Clara's brand identity end to end: visual system, voice and tone, and the narrative that ties product, marketing, and culture together — and be accountable for whether it lands, not just whether it looks good.

Build and lead a brand team — designers, writers, motion and production talent — recruiting exceptional people and creating the conditions for them to do their best work.

Build AI-powered brand production tooling: design and ship the workflows, templates, and AI-assisted systems that let non-designers across Clara produce on-brand work without bottlenecking every asset through your team. Think prompt libraries, generative image workflows, copy scaffolding, automated asset resizing — built and iterated, not just imagined.

Prototype fast, validate faster: go from brand brief to working asset or system in days, test it against real usage and perception, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does.

Set up the operating rhythm for brand work — intake, briefs, reviews, approvals — so work moves quickly without sacrificing quality.

Lead by making when it counts: concept development, art direction, and hands-on craft on Clara's highest-stakes brand moments — launches, campaigns, major events, the moments people remember.

Partner with Product Marketing, Growth, and Sales to ensure brand shows up consistently across every customer touchpoint, from the website to the sales deck to the app itself.

Partner with People and Recruiting to make Clara's employer brand as sharp and intentional as its customer-facing brand.

Establish the metrics and feedback loops that show whether brand investment is working — awareness, perception, consistency, and business impact — and report on it in plain, honest terms.

Who You Are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

8+ years in brand, creative, or design leadership, including experience building or scaling a brand function at a high-growth company, agency, or in-house creative team.

A portfolio of brand work you've led end-to-end — identity systems, rebrands, or campaigns that measurably shaped how a company was perceived.

A track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing creative teams.

Strong operational instincts: you've built creative processes that scale, and you can explain them clearly — not just describe good taste.

Hands-on experience using AI in creative production — not just a point of view on it, but actual workflows you've built or adopted to scale output without diluting quality. You've shipped things using generative tools, not just experimented with them.

Excellent craft across visual identity, typography, voice, and motion, with the judgment to know when to lead by example and when to delegate.

Comfort partnering with Marketing, Product, Sales, People, and executive leadership — strong written and verbal communication in English.

A bias toward building and shipping over speccing and aligning — you'd rather put a rough version in front of people this week than circulate a perfect brief next month.

Nice to haves

Background in fintech, B2B SaaS, or another trust-driven category — what matters most is a track record of building brands people remember, but the context helps.

Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese, given Clara's footprint across MX, BR, CO, and AR.

Experience working directly with founders or C-level on brand-defining moments.

Startup or small-team experience where you owned something end to end, from idea to production.

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.
Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

You'll join at a stage where Clara's brand is still being defined region-wide. That means real license to shape it — and real accountability for making it distinctive, consistent, and something customers and employees are genuinely proud to be associated with.

You'll report to the Head of Design and partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Clara's founders on the moments that define the brand.

What You'll Do

- Own Clara's brand identity end to end: visual system, voice and tone, and the narrative that ties product, marketing, and culture together — and be accountable for whether it lands, not just whether it looks good.

- Build and lead a brand team — designers, writers, motion and production talent — recruiting exceptional people and creating the conditions for them to do their best work.

- Build AI-powered brand production tooling: design and ship the workflows, templates, and AI-assisted systems that let non-designers across Clara produce on-brand work without bottlenecking every asset through your team. Think prompt libraries, generative image workflows, copy scaffolding, automated asset resizing — built and iterated, not just imagined.

- Prototype fast, validate faster: go from brand brief to working asset or system in days, test it against real usage and perception, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does.

- Set up the operating rhythm for brand work — intake, briefs, reviews, approvals — so work moves quickly without sacrificing quality.

- Lead by making when it counts: concept development, art direction, and hands-on craft on Clara's highest-stakes brand moments — launches, campaigns, major events, the moments people remember.

- Partner with Product Marketing, Growth, and Sales to ensure brand shows up consistently across every customer touchpoint, from the website to the sales deck to the app itself.

- Partner with People and Recruiting to make Clara's employer brand as sharp and intentional as its customer-facing brand.

- Establish the metrics and feedback loops that show whether brand investment is working — awareness, perception, consistency, and business impact — and report on it in plain, honest terms.

Who You Are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

8+ years in brand, creative, or design leadership, including experience building or scaling a brand function at a high-growth company, agency, or in-house creative team.

A portfolio of brand work you've led end-to-end — identity systems, rebrands, or campaigns that measurably shaped how a company was perceived.

A track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing creative teams.

Strong operational instincts: you've built creative processes that scale, and you can explain them clearly — not just describe good taste.

Hands-on experience using AI in creative production — not just a point of view on it, but actual workflows you've built or adopted to scale output without diluting quality. You've shipped things using generative tools, not just experimented with them.

Excellent craft across visual identity, typography, voice, and motion, with the judgment to know when to lead by example and when to delegate.

Comfort partnering with Marketing, Product, Sales, People, and executive leadership — strong written and verbal communication in English.

A bias toward building and shipping over speccing and aligning — you'd rather put a rough version in front of people this week than circulate a perfect brief next month.

Nice to haves

Background in fintech, B2B SaaS, or another trust-driven category — what matters most is a track record of building brands people remember, but the context helps.

Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese, given Clara's footprint across MX, BR, CO, and AR.

Experience working directly with founders or C-level on brand-defining moments.

Startup or small-team experience where you owned something end to end, from idea to production.

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.
Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.
